What I've built

A closer look at the robotics and leadership work I've put the most time into — from ground-up mechanical builds to running a competitive team.

01 Design / Build In Progress

Cycloidal Drive Gearbox

A custom 20:1 cycloidal drive gearbox designed and fabricated for NEMA 17 motors, targeting improved torque for compact robotic joints. Engineering toward integration into a 6-axis robotic arm for object manipulation (in progress).

Type: Independent build Focus: Mechanical design

Cyber Robotics

Iowa State's competitive robotics team. I serve as President for the 2026–2027 season, in addition to my role as Mechanical Team Lead, and served as Executive Competition Director this past semester — overseeing team direction, mechanical development, and competition strategy.

03 Competitive Robotics

Phantom Robotics

High School VEX Robotics Club, where I served as team lead for 4 consecutive years, overseeing mechanical design and system integration. My team is well known within the state as a top contender, winning the state championship 3 years in a row, along with placing in the top 100 in the country four years consecutively.
